items.title: 为什么《Control Resonant》开发商 Remedy 避免使用黄色油漆来引导玩家

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260930/IEffDqbudxfpicm.jpg!a-3-480x.jpg
Control Resonant 的总监解释了团队如何处理探索机制，使其不会像“黄色油漆”引导那样让玩家感到被过度干预。
几年来，一些玩家开始觉得游戏提供的引导超出了必要范围。其中一个例子就是“黄色油漆”，它基本上明确标注了玩家在探索过程中需要去的地方。批评者认为，当这种导航辅助手段过于生硬时，会分散注意力并削弱玩家的自主感。例如，漫威金刚狼 曾因其“气味追踪”（fart gas）而备受批评，这是一种蓝色的雾气，金刚狼可以通过嗅觉找到目标。发布后不久，开发商 Insomniac 增加了将其关闭的功能。

Control Resonant 的开发商 Remedy 并未对玩家进行说教式的引导。这是一款拥有可供玩家自由探索区域的开放世界游戏，尽管有时去向并非一目了然。Control Resonant 的总监 Mikael Kasurinen 在播客中解释说，让玩家感觉到是自己在理清这个复杂的世界，而不是跟随闪烁的箭头，这一点至关重要。他指出，为了让玩家从世界中获得最大收益，他们必须成为积极的参与者。
“玩家感觉到是自己在解决问题，这非常重要，”Kasurinen 说道，“作为创作者，我们的工作是……我的意思是，这终究是一种精心设计的体验，对吧？你必须在‘这就是世界’和‘这是你需要注意的不同主题和元素’之间找到平衡。但必须让玩家觉得，是你在决定如何处理在世界中看到的那些元素。如果感觉像是‘去这里’，那对玩家来说就不再是一个决定了，而是有人已经替你做好了决定。”
这位总监接着指出，Remedy 意识到这可能会疏远那些寻求更具引导性和简单体验的玩家，但对于那些真正投入其中的玩家来说，这将更具回报感和趣味性。
“人们会回到这款游戏中，进行探索，尝试发现事物等等，”他补充道，“这不像那种你走个过场，按要求做了就结束的游戏。它给人的感觉是，不，我在这个游戏中做了一些选择，你会产生一个小小的疑问：我做的选择对吗？我想要这种该死的问题。我希望人们那样思考。我希望他们产生怀疑，回头再看，重新检查，看看他们能做出什么不同的选择，因为这就是生活。这就是让游戏具有粘性和趣味性的原因。”
另一家与 Remedy 理念相似的开发商是 Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons 的工作室 Invoke。Invoke Studios 的总经理 Dominic Guay 在 2026 年科隆游戏展上表示，开发人员避免在游戏中设置路径点，因为他们希望玩家能够真正去探索。
这款开放世界单人动作冒险游戏通过放弃引导玩家从一个剧情章节直接进入下一个剧情章节的传统任务标记，减轻了“手把手”的引导感。虽然屏幕顶部确实有一个指南针（你可以将其关闭），但玩家需要通过探索、与 NPC 交谈以及思考下一步该做什么来弄清楚该去哪里。
“我们希望他们与世界互动，弄清楚事情，并感觉到当他们发现事物时，是基于他们的行动，而不仅仅是盲目地信任路径点，”Guay 说。
Control Resonant 的评分为 8/10。评测中提到：“即使战斗的锋芒最终变得迟钝，Control Resonant 也是 Remedy 宇宙的一个伟大补充。虽然它的故事遵循一个更标准的框架，但其吸引力在于围绕它构建的创意世界，以及让超自然悬疑落地的人性化设计。”

items.title: Steam Frame：VR 的未来，还是走向终结的起点？

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260930/QiDTJPbudxfpgkk.jpg!a-3-480x.jpg

我一直热爱 VR。三年前，我花了大约 300 英镑/ 400 美元购买了现在的头显——Pico 4。虽然由于某些存疑的原因，该特定型号在美国无法购买，但如果我想要一个替代方案并愿意进入扎克伯格的“围墙花园”（我不愿意），Quest 3S 甚至更便宜。凭借良好的无线支持、彩色透视摄像头以及在连接 PC 之前就已拥有的强大原生游戏库，我觉得 VR 终于达到了它应有的水平。这是一个全新的游戏世界，准入门槛甚至比任天堂 Switch 2 还要低。

虽然我理解内存价格在飙升，但当 Valve 宣布其进入轻量化无线 VR 领域的最低配 Steam Frame 型号售价高达令人咋舌的 889 英镑/ 1059 美元时，我的心沉了下去。更糟糕的是，它没有推出任何新的配套软件。Steam Frame 的杀手级应用？是一个原生移植版的 半条命：艾利克斯，不可否认这是一款优秀的游戏，但它是在 2020 年发布的，且由于 Valve 自身缺乏支持，其 Mod 社区在很大程度上已经停滞不前。

甚至 Steam Frame 的商店页面也自豪地将 Moss Book 2 列为你可以在该设备上玩到的杰作之一。虽然它确实很棒（许多 VR 游戏也是如此——这里的游戏库肯定让任何主机都相形见绌），但开发商 Polyarc 最近由于销量和资金不足而倒闭了，即便是在发布了非 VR 版本之后。虽然 VR 游戏仍在稳步产出，但在 PC 端，几乎所有的大型厂商都已经退场。没有值得期待的 3A 大作。VR 设计没有重大的下一步。而通过 Valve 的新硬件进入这一领域的成本，是我愿意为头显支付的价格的三倍。在 Meta 新发布的轻量化 VR 眼镜的情况下，这个价格甚至是四倍。
尽管如此，我依然热爱 VR。它填补了我生活中光枪游戏和带有一次性外设的古怪游戏（为 朋友一起来桑巴 和 Steel Battalion 举杯）曾占据的空缺。它拥有一些最酷的机甲游戏、最恐怖的荒野冒险和极具实验性的街机体验。VR 不会消失，新的硬件在缓慢而稳定地推出，Mod 作者们也在不断地为经典老游戏提供 VR 支持补丁。但我同样无法想象 VR 的未来会是什么样子，甚至不知道它是否还有未来。
VR 填补了我生活中光枪游戏和带有一次性外设的古怪游戏曾占据的空缺

如果 Valve 和 Meta 的说法可信，那么 VR 并非低端掌机的替代品。它是那些有钱可烧的技术发烧友的领域。它是一个几乎没有大工作室参与的完整媒介，甚至 Meta 上周的大型发布会也只是一些“经典”游戏的翻版和移植，而且其中许多仍将是 Meta 硬件独占。Valve 拥有富可敌国的财富，但如果不将其中的一部分投入到开发者身上，我担心除非 Frame 卖得异常出色，否则它也会失去对这个领域的兴趣。
虽然我爱我那廉价且通用的轻便头显，也喜欢为经典游戏添加 VR Mod 以用全新的方式体验它们，但我希望 VR 能够再次成长并获得支持。我希望能看到地平线上出现一些宏大、新颖且令人兴奋的东西，让其他人也能加入我的行列。而一款六年前游戏的移植版，无论它有多出色，都是远远不够的。

content.v: 在所有已公布的Switch 2移植游戏中，《怪物猎人：荒野》或许会成为最令人印象深刻的作品之一。它拥有广阔的开放世界、大量精心制作的动作动画，以及流畅的在线多人游戏体验，让玩家可以尽情挑战强大的Boss。许多《怪物猎人》系列游戏都曾登陆任天堂掌机平台，但很少有游戏像《荒野》这样最初面向高端主机和PC平台开发的。据Capcom透露，《怪物猎人：荒野》 Switch 2版的目标并不是将画面缩水从而能在较弱设备上运行，而是从零开始重制这款游戏，尽可能做到没有什么重大妥协。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260930/1790720729_539253_jpg_r.jpg
在最近接受Kotaku采访时，制作人Genki Sunano：表示“ 《怪物猎人：荒野》Switch 2版的开发理念是，在Switch 2上呈现原汁原味的《怪物猎人：荒野》体验。换句话说，我们不想让它感觉像一个简单的移植版，仅仅为了让游戏能在Switch 2上运行而降低画面或性能。相反，我们的目标是在不牺牲游戏体验的前提下，将《怪物猎人：荒野》带到Switch 2上。”
他表示， 《怪物猎人：荒野》 Switch 2版的性能目标是在掌机模式下稳定运行在30帧，即使是四人联机 狩猎 也不例外。
“ 《荒野》包含了海量的元素，因此我们必须仔细评估每个元素的素材和底层处理，确定哪些需要保留，哪些可以在不改变整体体验的前提下进行调整，正是这种细致入微、有时看似永无止境的决策和优化过程，让我们在打造舒适的掌机体验的同时，保留《荒野》的独特魅力，成为了我们面临的最大挑战之一。”
这种精益求精的制作过程的一个例子是，他们从零开始为Switch 2版本重建了某些素材和着色器。团队致力于设计“更高效的实现方式”，同时尽可能保留游戏的原始画面，确保Switch 2玩家能够获得与其他平台玩家相同的优质游戏体验，没有任何劣势。当团队修改视觉特效素材等内容时，他们会确保新版本仍然与现有的碰撞箱和碰撞检测机制兼容。
“通过这个过程，我们将资源集中投入到直接影响游戏体验的领域。与此同时，我们对之前认为已针对家用游戏机硬件进行了充分优化的领域进行了更深入的审视。为了让游戏能够在掌机硬件上流畅运行，我们重新评估了这些领域的方方面面，并用更高效的解决方案替换了某些视觉技术和内部处理方法。我们计划将通过这个项目获得的知识和经验应用于《怪物猎人：荒野之息》发布前，对现有平台进行的性能优化。”
Capcom制作人表示，此次开发过程带来的好处仅限于Switch 2移植版游戏，但这种学习经历或许也能帮助他们思考其他平台的游戏开发。
12月4日《怪物猎人：荒野》登陆任天堂主机后，我们就能知道这一切是否值得了。

items.title: Deadlock 的巨大新更新为其城市披上了一层诡异的新色彩，并首次亮相了 6 位新英雄，其中包括唯一的鼠王
items.summary: Valve continues to polish the game into one of the moodiest MOBAs out there.

content.v: The cursed city where Deadlock's battles take place just got even spookier than it already was in the City Never Sleeps update . Valve's second major overhaul for the invite-only MOBA marks another major step in its pseudo-early access development, giving it a much stronger visual identity than it had before, six striking new heroes, and a massive list of tweaks to how it plays.

Deadlock's entire map has been redecorated into three distinct themes: a bright city center, a haunted university, and a shadowy stock exchange. All the buildings and creeps that inhabit each street have been redesigned to fit in. There are pickle jars with hands growing out of them lurking in the heart of the map, sentient stacks of books in the right lane, and slimy trashbag monsters in the left lane.

Squeezed between it all are four districts with their own identities, like a theater district infested with literal stage hands pulling the strings on steampunk-style automatons. Atop the Chinatown district is a bell tower where teams can fight over a fountain of souls to try to get a currency advantage in a tight match. Even the wooden crates that players smash for resources are now padlocked and bolted shut.

It's a whole new playground that will take some time for players to fully figure out. In the meantime, Valve has prepared six new heroes who will be released based on a player voting system, just like the previous set . My money's on the Rat King taking the lead because, well, he's the Rat King, a crowned rodent that began as a fan concept a year ago and quickly became a meme in the community.

Don't get me wrong, though, the others look great, too. Valve made a nurse who holds a needle like a gun, a Chess master who seems to float like Overwatch's Zenyatta, a skeleton who found a rocket launcher, a cozy old witch who I do not trust, and a young artist who wields a paintbrush. Two heroes will drop each week with the first making their debut on Friday.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Jtf5LFi9ZQjUh2qhc7DdeW-1920-80.jpg
Here's some other big changes I see on the update page:

All of this is only a fraction of the things Valve has added to the game, some of which it's intentionally keeping a secret so players can discover them on their own. Despite the size of the update, Valve hasn't removed the need for an invite to play Deadlock. One has to wonder how many of these it will take before the game is finally released to the public so everyone can get a taste of what Valve's been cooking up.

items.title: 《皇牌空战 8》Steam 评论者对其预购奖励并非独立应用程序感到愤怒
items.summary: The fine print for freebie Ace Combat Zero changed before launch.

content.v: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve is technically out on Thursday, but as is commonplace now folks who pre-order the $90 deluxe edition get to hop into the cockpit a few days early. Anyone who pre-orders the $70 standard edition, meanwhile, gets a pretty sweet bonus: Ace Combat Zero, a 2006 entry in the series that has never been on PC before now. But how Bandai Namco has packaged Zero is now threatening to drag the new game's Steam review average down into Mixed territory.

Of the nearly 1,000 negative reviews as of this writing, there's a spread of complaints—performance, multiplayer connectivity, weightier flight physics, lacking HOTAS support—but one of the most common refrains is that the Zero bonus has been something of a bait-and-switch. As summarized by reviewer Akion :
"Before I bought the game the description said this about the Belkan War DLC Half the reason I got the game was because that is my all time fav. The integrity of this should matter to you.
"'*ACE COMBAT ZERO: THE BELKAN WAR is a standalone application separate from the ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE full game.'
"And now it says this:
"*ACE COMBAT ZERO: THE BELKAN WAR (Steam Version) is available as a DLC executable launched separately from the base game."
So why does this matter?

As another reviewer points out, "You need to install 140gb of data to play a 3gb 20 years old game." That's not an exaggeration: Ace Combat 8 is currently using up 140.24 gigs on my SSD, with the Zero DLC making up only 3.2GB of that total.

There's also a clear strain of dissatisfaction with the fact that on consoles, Zero comes along with its own achievements/trophies list, which is absent for the Steam version. Since it's tied to AC8, Zero also lacks separate cloud saves, something that would be pretty nice for playing it on the Steam Deck, where it should run very well given its age.

The lack of parity with the console version clearly has quite a few players annoyed, but the principle of the thing seems to be the biggest sticking point. The store page said Zero would be a separate app, and then it wasn't.

Some folks have countered that Bandai Namco couldn't release Zero as its own package due to the licensing terms of the planes featured in the game, seemingly based on this livestream featuring the developers on September 28 saying the licenses only permit giving the game away for free. But clearly it's possible to package the game separately on consoles even without selling it, and I'm skeptical it's impossible to find some kind of workaround on Steam. Hitman 3 still has a listing page, for example, despite not being purchasable by itself—it's listed as downloadable content for Hitman World of Assassination.

"Notice: At the request of the publisher, HITMAN 3 Access Pass: HITMAN 1 Complete First Season is unlisted on the Steam store and will not appear in search," reads a warning message at the top of the store page.

This criticism will soon show up in a smaller portion of Ace Combat 8's reviews as players who didn't bother to pre-order begin to filter into the reaction pool, but for now the pre-order bonus isn't quite the clean publicity win it otherwise could've been.

content.v: 面对硬件价格持续上涨，前索尼互动娱乐全球工作室总裁吉田修平认为，索尼与任天堂应尽可能延长PS5和Switch2主机寿命。他在《The Verge》的Vergecast节目中表示，两家公司已售出足够多的现世代硬件。考虑到成本，平台方可能会考虑推迟推出下一代产品，他也赞成尽量维持当前世代。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260930/1790716802_663600_jpg_r.jpg
吉田修平认为，玩家可支配的预算有限，电脑和主机所需专用组件的价格涨幅又高于其他娱乐形式。已经拥有PS5、Switch2或性能足够的电脑的人，未必愿意马上换设备。他以自己为例：五年前购买游戏电脑后，他曾考虑升级，却因价格上涨推迟了计划，并后悔没有提前一年购买。
在他看来，许多玩家并未迫切要求更强的硬件，开发者也未必正在要求新设备。因此，他判断索尼与任天堂的现有主机仍有望持续表现多年。谈到Xbox时，吉田修平认为其处境不同，因为它希望改变竞争格局。
Switch2于2025年推出，任天堂仍在支持初代Switch。PS5与XSX|S则将在2026年11月迎来上市六周年。索尼以往约每隔六至七年推出新一代PlayStation，但索尼和任天堂目前都没有公布下一代主机的确定发布时间。

items.title: 在游戏被“修复”之前喜欢它的奇怪经历
items.summary: Has this ever happened to you?

content.v: I was one of the weirdos who gave Battlefield 2042 a positive review at the same time as it was being called the worst Battlefield of all time.

Its detractors weren't wrong, we were just coming at it from different perspectives. BF 2042's giant 128-player maps did have desolate stretches where you could wind up stranded, hoofing it without cover, but I liked that. It created eerie, lonely moments that brought me back to playing Battlefield 1942, as did the glitchy hovercrafts (Battlefield games are supposed to have wonky physics!) and the goofy custom game modes you could make with the Portal scripting tool.

I could go on, but suffice it to say that I wasn't singing in the same key as the rest of the chorus, and EA launched an extended 'we're listening to your feedback' campaign, overhauling the maps and refocusing on 64-player modes to 'fix' the game. They weren't wrong to do it, but I didn't go back much.

I had a similar experience with No Man's Sky: What an odd game that was at launch, when it was engulfed in an inferno of criticism and accusations. Expectations for the endless space exploration game had gotten out of hand—thanks in part to some fuzzy marketing verbiage from developer Hello Games—but I remember liking the eerie solitude. (Maybe a pattern in my tastes is emerging here.)

No Man's Sky is now one of gaming's great redemption stories. Hello Games weathered that cosmic-scale scorn and remade it into a game that, for many, is much more like the game they'd wanted and expected back in 2016, with 32-player multiplayer and base building.

It's a great story, and Hello Games has earned a lot of respect for it, which funnily has us all smiling and clapping for the upcoming Light No Fire , another game inspiring enormous, probably too-high expectations.
But that original, 2016 version of No Man's Sky still sticks in my mind as a singular experience. Hello Games founder Sean Murray also remains fond of it.

"I've gone back to the original, played the game without any updates," Murray told us recently . "And I've got a real soft spot for it, to be honest. It's a more esoteric experience. It's a little bit weirder, but it's got its charm."

The post-launch work on both of these games obviously improved them for a lot of people, and in the case of No Man's Sky has resulted in a decade of happy spacefaring (fans even paid for a billboard ad to show their appreciation).
But I do lightly object to the common use of the word 'fixed' in the context of these overhauls, as if realigning a game's design is equivalent to solving a driver issue.

Murray got himself in trouble playing coy about the multiplayer features No Man's Sky didn't have in 2016, but it was still a cool game back then, and nothing has been quite like it since—not even No Man's Sky.

items.title: Coinbase 加入 Pokémon TCG 炒作，推出自己的数字开包服务
items.summary: Coinbase is joining the Pokémon TCG craze with its own digital pack-opening platform.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/29/coinbase-pokemon-card-pack-opening-service-1790714692482.jpg
Coinbase is joining the Pokémon TCG craze with its own digital pack-opening platform.

Coinbase, a US-based cryptocurrency exchange platform, is moving in on the TCG market with a particular focus on Pokémon. At least, that’s what it seems like, based on a tweet it published on September 28.
“Your binder is about to get a major upgrade,” the post reads. “Rip packs on your phone. Every pull backed by a real, physical card. Vault it or ship it. Soon on Coinbase.”
Your binder is about to get a major upgrade. Rip packs on your phone. Every pull backed by a real, physical card. Vault it or ship it. Soon on Coinbase. pic.twitter.com/Utfwq30DSj
While the post’s text doesn’t mention Pokémon by name, the accompanying image attached to it shows mockups of five Pokémon TCG card packs that are labeled ‘Pokémon’ with the numbers 1-5.

The platform also responded to a few comments that mentioned the popular monster-catching franchise; one user wrote, “Pokémon packs on the chain, trading cards just hit peak convenience,” to which it replied, “You get it.”
“STFU, Coinbase is going to partner with and onboard everything on earth,” another wrote, to which Coinbase responded, “Well, we are the Everything Exchange.”
Based on this post, it looks like Coinbase users will soon be able to open digital card packs, with the option to place those cards in a digital ‘vault’ or receive their physical equivalent by mail.

However, another reply from Coinbase suggests there’ll be some additional features at play; one user wrote, “The vaulting aspect is the real game changer here,” to which it replied, “And there’s more…”

For now, details remain sparse. We don’t know how Coinbase’s status as a crypto platform will impact its attempt at a pack-opening service, nor how it intends to grade said cards or provide proof of ownership. Will these pulls come from pre-opened packs? Who’s to say.

It’s also worth noting that such a service, sans cryptocurrency, already exists; as pointed out by Dexerto , Gamestop’s Power Packs program also features a digital option, allowing customers to open mystery packs online and receive those cards’ physical counterparts.

Gamestop assures its buyers that every digital pack contains a "real, authenticated item” that they can either hold in their digital PSA vault, have shipped to them, or take advantage of its instant buyback program and use those funds to purchase another card pack. It remains to be seen if Coinbase will provide similar guarantees.

Coinbase’s proposed pack-opening platform comes on the heels of Pokémon’s 30th Anniversary celebration, which has shone a spotlight on the ever-growing hype around the card collecting scene, as well as the scalpers who have caused chaos during its special merchandise and card launches.

For instance, the special 30th Anniversary card pack drops at retailers like Target and other shops prompted long lines outside stores as mobs of fans showed up for the chance at snagging some packs for themselves, with some even ‘reserving’ spots in line by setting out chairs with no one sitting in them.

items.title: Wardogs 老板谈论平衡性、XP 以及为什么现在“结局很糟糕”
items.summary: Bulkhead is aware of the "mortar spam meta."

content.v: Dev Reacts: @jbowendaman made an awesome video that I thought warranted a response this morning about balancing and XP. Appreciate you all still playing our game, this video ended up longer than I thought! Link to orginal video: https://t.co/1tF0F9Mo94 pic.twitter.com/ERi8CltXVK September 29, 2026
A few notable quotes from Bulkhead CEO Joe Brammer's latest Wardogs discussion video on X, in which he reacts to a video from YouTuber JbowenDaMan .

Wardogs continues to be one of my favorite games of the year, but almost three weeks into early access, I understand why developer Bulkhead was anticipating agita as players got deeper into its progression. The 100-player FPS has a serious XP grind , and some say they were having a better time before the most dedicated players started unlocking the highest tiers of vehicles, armor, and weapons.

Brammer's insights on player feedback and the studio's philosophy on balance are a useful lens into how Bulkhead sees its game—first and foremost a sandbox shooter where no two matches are the same, and not a competitive FPS that requires perfect balance.

"Sometimes in our game, we're going to be OK with something being a bit overpowered for a season and then underpowered next season, to keep it interesting," he said. "That doesn't mean I think level four armor is working, or that our balancing is great. I think the endgame is a bit sh*t."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/coHabSYDGh5XZTEM8avhZE-1920-80.jpg

It can be quite discouraging to face heavily-armored players with a pea shooter, or get smacked around by the strongest vehicles, so I'm curious what Bulkhead is considering to improve the endgame. Many think the thicker armors should go away entirely, and I admit I've had the same reaction when my killers shrug off six bullets to the chest, but that would rid the game of valuable build variety.

Wardogs firefights are asymmetrical by nature, and I wouldn't want to change that. While I'm unlocking stuff slower than the best players, the truth is that I'm also playing like a cheapskate—buying level two armor and cheaper guns because I don't want to risk a $20k loadout. Going into fights at a disadvantage is its own thrill, because I can still eat a bigger fish by getting the drop on them, and then become the bigger fish by looting their stuff.

Top of my mind is the changing playstyles of Wardogs week-to-week. Recently I've had a lot of matches where very few teammates want to do my favorite thing—push the Hot Zone and fight—and instead choose to focus on building or attacking FOBs. It can be frustrating to the point of not wanting to play, but as Jbowen and Brammer note, Wardogs is more fun when you're willing to adapt what you're doing to the current shape of the match. Instead of getting annoyed, I could try to pivot to hunting FOBs, learning anti-air, or practicing my pilot skills.

Brammer also reminded folks that Wardogs' planned metagame features will affect progression in the future. Bulkhead plans to add Tarkov-style skills that are improved through repetition, like tactical sprint duration and staying in-scope when cycling a sniper rifle bolt. Skills will be persistent, not wiped from season to season. In addition to cash and XP, a future "intel" resource will be used for unlocking gun parts and attachments that go beyond the current crop of grips, scopes, and muzzles.
"You're playing 25% of the game," as Brammer put it.

Sounds intriguing and intimidating. I really like how approachable Wardogs is right now, and my experience with full gunsmith systems in Battlefield 6 and CoD have me worried players will optimize guns until they're boring, but maybe Bulkhead's approach will be different.

items.title: 该算法适用于 Steam 的折扣和活动
items.summary: Things are changing in 2027.

content.v: More changes are coming to the way you buy games on Steam.
WHAT IT MEANS

Steam's Discounts and Events page is, as the name suggests, basically a collection of discounted games and special events: The Nier Franchise Sale, Game Devs of Color Expo, some lifts from your wishlist, and some that just match up with stuff you've done in the past. But all of them are "curated placements," which means they're scheduled by either developers or publishers themselves, or by Steam.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/sGjAx5fg6A8MdZ7ErXTbRe-1920-80.png

But Steam, as we all know, is always looking to refine the online game shopping experience, which is where these "dynamic and personalized" recommendations come in: "More discounted games or sale events will have the chance to be visible on the homepage and elsewhere on Steam, rather than be limited by a small, fixed number of slots."

Valve continues: "We have confidence this approach is better aligned with our goal, and results in a better experience for customers and developers. The constraint of a manually managed calendar doesn't make as much sense with such diverse customer tastes and so many relevant deals for customers available at any given time."

There was a bit of early confusion about what exactly Valve is doing here, and concerns that Valve would be pursuing the practice of dynamic pricing—that is, adjusting prices on the fly to reflect the demands of the moment. But it's the recommendations that are going dynamic, not the prices, so—assuming there are no unpleasant surprises in store—it's what you'll see that will be changing, not what you'll pay.
SEEMS FINE THEN?

At this early stage, yeah. Look, I'm a little tired of dancing to the tune of algorithms, and I wonder too if some people won't wind up missing out on cool stuff that maybe falls outside their usual areas of interest if they're only presented with what Steam knows they're likely to buy.

On the whole, though—and acknowledging that we don't have any details on how it will actually work just yet—it seems fine to me. Finding visibility on Steam is a never-ending challenge for indie developers, and if this puts more games in front of more eyeballs, it's hard not to see it as at least a small win.
None of this will be happening for a while, to be clear: A hard rollout date hasn't been set but Valve expects to start the process in early 2027.

items.title: Pokémon VGC Pro 恳求玩家在对手的“腐烂”恶臭导致呕吐后洗手
items.summary: A professional Pokémon player is going viral after begging his fellow competitors to keep up with their person

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/29/pokemon-vgc-player-stinky-tournament-1790711842664.jpg
A professional Pokémon player is going viral after begging his fellow competitors to keep up with their personal hygiene, claiming he literally threw up at an event due to someone’s stench.
Texas-based Pokémon VGC regional champion Donghun Youm says he lost his lunch at the 2026 Baltimore Regional Championships thanks to a super smelly player.
Youm wrote about his experience in a viral post on Twitter/X, where he begged players to “please take care of [their] personal hygiene.”
Youm said someone at the competition smelled so foul that he literally threw up because of it, and his friends were unable to concentrate on their own matches due to the putrid stench.

“I've had an incident at Baltimore regionals where I had to throw up due to a nearby player's stench,” he said. “My friends and I couldn't focus that round due to how putrid the smell was, and we even told a judge due to it. Like, c'mon man....”

Youm’s post has kicked off a heated discourse about players’ hygiene at competitions, as well as no end of jokes and memes about certain Pokémon attacks that rely on smell to deal damage or inflict adverse status effects. (The ability ‘Stench’ was most popular, as it has a 10% chance of making your opponent flinch when hit by a damaging move.)

Please take care of your personal hygiene. I've had an incident @ Baltimore regionals where I had to throw up due to a nearby player's stench. My friends and I couldn't focus that round due to how putrid the smell was and we even told a judge due to it. Like c'mon man....
“[Washing] should be a requirement to attend an event,” one commenter replied. “People who smell bad should be kicked out.”
“If you can afford a Nintendo Switch, you can afford a $3 stick of deodorant dude,” another said.

This is far from the first time the subject of hygiene has come up regarding in-person gaming events; in June, a card shop in Oregon suspended its Yu-Gi-Oh tournaments after receiving bad reviews and multiple complaints of smelly patrons.
The shop pointed to Konami’s own tournament guidelines, which stipulate that everyone at a Yu-Gi-Oh competition, not just players, must be “clean and wear clean clothing,” or risk being “penalized.”

Pokémon boasts similar rules; the official Play! Pokemon Tournament Rules Handbook includes a section regarding hygiene, which reads, “Individuals are also required to maintain a socially acceptable level of hygiene during the event. Depending on the attire or level of hygiene, the Tournament Organizer may allow for a tournament participant to change or update their personal hygiene and attire and return to the venue.
"If a participant refuses to comply with tournament staff’s requests, this is grounds for removal from the tournament and venue, and the participant must relinquish their badge to tournament staff."

It’s unclear if the stinky player who caused Youm to throw up was penalized. Either way, the incident has sparked renewed calls from community members for their fellow players to keep themselves clean and fresh at competitions to avoid unpleasant situations like this one.

items.title: 据称《魔兽世界：永恒》调查预告了 11 个新职业，其中包括一些深度删减
items.summary: World of Warcraft : Forever's new take on classic Azeroth is opening the door to all kinds of new ideas in the

content.v: World of Warcraft : Forever's new take on classic Azeroth is opening the door to all kinds of new ideas in the old-school version of Blizzard's MMORPG, and new classes look to be one of them.

Blizzard, of course, has added a total of four new classes over the last two decades to the modern version of WoW: Death Knight, Monk, Demon Hunter, and Evoker. But an alleged leaked survey pushed to select WoW players via Blizzard's Battle.net launcher is now asking about potential new classes for WoW: Forever , the recently revealed third version of the MMO that will introduce new quests, zones, and content to the "vanilla" version of WoW.

It's not the first time Blizzard has conducted a survey this way, and while Blizzard asks participants not to disclose the survey's details , their contents almost always find their way online. That's the case here, as players were quick to share information about 11 potential new classes listed in the survey, and content creators like Bellular have gone as far as to provide a full breakdown. Information contained about each of these potential classes includes basic lore, what types of weapons they would be able to use, the armor class they would wear, the resources they would use, what roles they would fill, and even signature abilities. The classes listed in the survery are:

Three of the new classes would essentially be "new," old-school versions of existing WoW classes like Demon Hunter, Monk, and Death Knight. Considering how fast-paced classes like Monk and Demon Hunter are in the modern version of the game, their Forever counterparts would likely feel significantly different.

It's the eight "new" classes that are the most exciting, however. Some of these are ideas that have existed in WoW lore for ages or ones that Blizzard even originally toyed with during the game's early development. The Tinker, for example, is a class many expect to come to the modern version of WoW at some point but is listed in the survey. They would be the ultimate engineer, capable of using mech suits and gadgets to tank, deal damage, and support other players.

Another potential class, the Necromancer, was an idea Blizzard originally had planned for vanilla WoW, only for it to eventually be scrapped. In Forever, Blizzard is proposing a version of the class that seems like it's taking some inspiration from Diablo 2's class of the same name, with abilities like Bone Spear and Corpse Explosion. The survey additionally lists the San'layn, a group of vampires who broke free of the Lich King's domination. This class seems like it would lean fully into the vampire fantasy, with a number of blood-based abilities that could make them similar to retail WoW's Blood Death Knight specialization.

Two other classes steeped in WoW lore proposed in the survey are the Warden and Runemaster. Wardens are the iconic Night Elf faction famous for hunting down and imprisoning Azeroth's greatest threats. How exactly that would work when it comes to Horde players is unclear, but the survey notes that the Wardens would open their ranks "out of necessity" in order to deal with greater threats.

Runemasters, on the other hand, are beings infused with power by the Titans who use a rune system that sounds similar to that of modern WoW's Death Knights to heal and fight. That rune system itself was originally for an early version of the Runemaster class that was later scrapped and its core mechanic repurposed. This class appears to have been listed by multiple different names in various versions of the survey, also appearing by the name Metalborn and Runeknight.

Other classes seem almost entirely new. The survey lists classes like Bard, Witch, and Illusionist among potential additions. The Bard sounds about like what you would expect, a healer and support class capable of buffing allies, while the Witch and Illusionists are two new flavors of spellcasters. Illusionists would summon and conjure creatures and objects to aid them in battle, while the Witch uses dark powers like blood rituals and even the power of the old gods to buff allies and destroy their foes.

Whether or not any or all of these potential new classes will eventually make their way into Forever remains to be seen, but Blizzard does have, well, forever to make them a reality. In the meantime there's plenty new for WoW: Forever players to discover, including over 1,000 new quests , four new zones, an account-wide Legacy perk system, and more. WoW: Forever's beta is currently live until October 21, with Forever's full launch set for November 4.

items.summary: GTA 6 will not include its own spoof on one of Florida's most iconic venues: Walt Disney World. I adore all th

content.v: GTA 6 will not include its own spoof on one of Florida's most iconic venues: Walt Disney World. I adore all things Disney, including the parks. But I also appreciate and enjoy Rockstar's penchant for sarcasm and making fun of things. And Disney World? There is a lot to poke fun at. So I am a bit bummed that Walt Disney World--or whatever Rockstar would name its simulacrum--won't appear in GTA 6.

Game Informer asked Rockstar if Florida's central region, including Orlando and its tourist destinations like Walt Disney World and Universal Studios, would be represented in GTA 6 in some form, and Jack McPherson said they wouldn't. However, McPherson stressed that GTA 6 will offer the "full Florida experience" in numerous other ways.

“We have to constantly evaluate the diversity of landscapes, towns, structures, landmarks, vistas, plant species, rock formations and everything else before we work with design and narrative to distill a list down that best works with and serves the game’s needs. So, while we may not have those exact locations, everything we have is geared to getting that full Florida experience!”
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Jason_and_Lucia_09_f7646b.jpg?w=636
GTA 6 also won't feature SeaWorld or Florida's iconic "Space Coast," featuring Cape Canaveral's historic launch pad.

I am not too surprised by any of this, though, considering GTA 6 takes place in Vice City, a stand-in for Miami, which is a four-hour, 230-mile drive from Orlando. I know GTA 6 is going to be a big game-- featuring the biggest game map Rockstar ever made --but I never expected the map to run all the way up to Orlando.

Jay Klaitz, who famously portrayed Lester in Grand Theft Auto 5, previously said in an interview that he wondered if Rockstar would create its own, legally distinct version of Disney World that could be called “Psycho Park.”
“That would be interesting too if they sort of delve into that environment,” he said.

While GTA 6 might not feature its own take on Disney World, it's possible the park could be referenced in GTA 6's radio chatter, and some spoofs could come there. The well runs deep for things Rockstar can make fun of Disney World for, including its ever-increasing ticket prices, the price to buy literally anything in the parks, and the so-called Disney Adult phenomenon, just to name a few options. I love Disney, but even the most diehard fans have their issues.

As it happens, the last game in the series, GTA 5, was set where Disneyland--the OG Disney park--is located in the Los Angeles area, and that game also did not feature its own theme park spoof that players could visit. However, GTA 5 featured a film production company known as Fred's Pictures , which was an obvious reference to Disney.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: 《光环》前系列创意总监认为动视《光环》有 3 条可能的发展路径
items.summary: Frank O'Connor, Halo's Franchise Creative Director for nearly 20 years at 343 Industries/Halo Studios, has wei

content.v: Frank O'Connor, Halo's Franchise Creative Director for nearly 20 years at 343 Industries/Halo Studios (who, fun fact, was once my colleague at Official Xbox Magazine), has weighed in on Halo's future at Activision , suggesting three viable paths forward for Xbox's former biggest franchise.

O'Connor, who moved on from 343 Industries in 2023, was responding to a post on LinkedIn by former Xbox Social Media Manager of Executive Communications Genevieve Harrison about Halo's move to Activision. Harrison was discussing how Activision might approach Halo, and said in part, "Talent is not a SharePoint folder you drag from /Call of Duty into /Halo and wait for the little green checkmark. What Activision does know how to do is run the absolute hell out of a giant franchise. Maybe that operational discipline is exactly what Halo needs. But Activision isn’t riding in to save Xbox either. Microsoft paid $68.7 billion for Activision Blizzard. Activision is Xbox. Maybe it works. I hope it does because I’d love another great Halo game."

O'Connor, who started on the Halo franchise when he left Official Xbox Magazine to join Bungie during Halo 2's development, replied with his thoughts on how the series's next step at its new developer and publisher might go. "There are 3 paths - any one of which COULD be successful," he said. "None of these are easy, guaranteed or necessarily viable: 1. Make a "classic" Halo movement/sandbox/shooter experience tailored to a core audience & scaled to be successful with that core audience and attractive to a broader one so it can grow (not to mention obvious fact that Halo MP is better w. more people playing, by mathematical default).

"2. Make something new, modern that >reinvents< the game/universe in a surprising but fantastic way. An action/sandbox game (maybe it's a new take on the FPS, maybe it's an action RPG but it's fundamentally different) and succeeds with a combination of strong story, IP use and gets a small head start based on curiosity or loyalty.

"3. Translate Halo IP and sandbox into the ATVI comfort zone. Use the player, progression and business models that are proven to work and craft a big annual or semi-annual spectacle and constant content. Pro-Tip: Do NOT tie it to hardware/services launch cycles, do not try to force it into a shape (or aging platform) that it can't fit and do NOT abandon sandbox. Pro-Pro-Tip: Hire Bungie, Halo Studios and other laid off folk who are bursting w. talent and ideas that got nerfed or shut down over the years."

Halo Studios went through a rebranding effort (from 343 Industries), a leadership shakeup, and a pivot to Unreal Engine as its underlying game technology in 2024, and shipped the multiplayer-less remake of the original Halo, called Halo: Campaign Evolved, earlier this year. However, the studio was reportedly years away on its next mainline Halo project ahead of Xbox CEO Asha Sharma and Xbox COO Matt Booty's decision to hand Halo to the House of Call of Duty. I've since written about whether or not Activision can save Halo , but I'm not as convinced on the creative side, while my colleague Matt Purslow wrote about how, no matter what, Halo must go beyond Bungie's original template .

content.v: Activision has confirmed that one of the Call of Duty franchise's most notorious maps, Shipment , is coming back for this year's Modern Warfare 4.
After fans spotted it in the newly released trailer for MW4's PC version , the Call of Duty account directly confirmed its return with a dedicated post.

Shipment, which debuted in 2007's Modern Warfare 4, is a tiny map filled with shipping containers that players can dash through. Due to its small size, players can get wiped out in their spawns easily, and the action generally is extremely chaotic. Some people love the map. Others hate it.
Shipment's return in 2026's MW4 is no big surprise, as it's been featured in numerous Modern Warfare games over the years. It also showed up in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Mobile .
While Activision has confirmed that Shipment will return in MW4, the company did not say if it will be among the 12 6v6 maps available at launch, or if it will be released sometime later.

For those who enjoy Shipment, its inclusion in MW4 is just the latest piece of good news. Before this, Activision confirmed that MW4 will finally fix how double XP tokens work and the dreaded "update requires restart" notice is going away . Additionally, MW4 will usher in a feature in Warzone that lets you avoid seeing all those wacky skins . The game also has a brand-new, Counter-Strike style mode .

Modern Warfare 4 launches on October 23 for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and PC. The game marks the first Call of Duty release on a Nintendo platform since 2013’s Call of Duty: Ghosts. It’s also the first game since Ghosts to skip PS4 and Xbox One.

items.title: 为什么这么多 Steam 游戏的名称都奇怪地相似（而且容易被遗忘）
items.summary: "Suddenly everything's called Rise of the Bonelord: Origins of Dust."

content.v: Duskfade. DUST: Origins. Dust Front RTS. Duskbloods. Dungeons of Dusk. These are all games that will be released in a 12-month period. I know the differences between them, but I'm convinced that no normal person would be able to remember all of these titles.

Dungeons of Dusk gets a pass, because it's a spin-off of a rad FPS that led the boomer shooter revival movement. That's easy enough to remember. Duskbloods is the new FromSoftware game, so there's no chance anyone will forget that.

But, I will pick on DUST: Origins and Duskfade . Want to know the origins of dust? That stuff gathering on your monitor and shelves? Dead skin (and other debris). That title stirs nothing within me, even though the game has some solid development pedigree behind it.

Duskfade is a perfectly pleasant 3D platformer with Kingdom Hearts-style combat that came out a couple of months ago. Once I've finished typing this paragraph, however, it will once again erase itself from my memory, because there's nothing evocative about the name.

So many video game names are either daft, interchangeable, or confusing. I got thinking about this because of a great thread by Hannah Flynn, communications director at Failbetter and a games marketing consultant. She's previously worked for brands like Penguin Books and Tate in the UK.

"Put aside what you think a game name should sound like," the advice reads. "There are thousands upon thousands of games on Steam now. Not all of them are named well, and there are weird trends which actually make your name less effective. Start with your game !"

That is surely the number one problem with most game names: people look at other games' names and try to pick something that sounds a bit like them. The result is often a flavourless mush that struggles to stay in the memory. To an outsider not already well-versed in the games marketplace, these often sound ridiculous.
The dust/dusk-relevant nugget I particularly like in Flynn's thread said to watch out for "filler" words like:
- "fall of" (11,527 results on Steam) - "echoes of" (2,750 results on Steam) - "shadow of" (8,243 results on Steam)
No offence to the developers of DUST: Origins, but 'origins' is absolutely of those words.

"There isn't a universal formula [for a good game name]," Flynn summarises. "But I like to think that a good name reflects the spirit of the game, and doesn't go out of its way to be un-memorable." She offers plenty of examples: Hades, Clickolding, Dave the Diver, Failbetter's own Sunless Skies.

This all resonated with me because I've been writing about games for 19 years, and I've seen a lot of bad game names in that time. A former colleague of mine used to bring up the games Violence Fight and Faster than Speed as being classically terrible titles for games—but those names are actually funny, whereas I think bland or generic names are much more annoying and widespread. In the Xbox 360 era where everyone wanted their version of Call of Duty or Gears of War, these proliferated.
Name that game
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/oBZUxUsC2Pg6gqfsn5jLjX-1920-80.jpg

I decided to ask Flynn a bit more about the hypotheses shared in her thread, hoping to dig into the unhinged thought process behind every game name that ends with 'unleashed' or 'chronicles'. "I've thought about this more than is reasonable," Flynn says.

"I've been making indie games at Failbetter Games for 12 years, and have also reviewed hundreds of Steam store pages for other teams. I've developed this interest in game naming out of a professional need, but also because I'm getting older and my memory is getting worse, and I'd like to be able to recall the names of games I want to play."

I empathise with Flynn's point on age. One test is whether you can still remember what a game is called 10 minutes after you saw it announced in one of Geoff Keighley's showcases. Sorry *checks notes* TARAE: The Unbound, but even though I watched that trailer just one month ago at Opening Night Live, my memory had flushed that one away before the livestream was even over. A bad game name can trip a developer at the starting line.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/eqvU23Cs5TE7TZTuDTyU5V-1920-80.jpg
When developers look to other games to name theirs, "The possibility space spirals in on itself, and suddenly everything's called Rise of the Bonelord: Origins of Dust," she says.

"It's a fragment of a broader insularity in the industry. You can tell when games are only inspired by other games. I'm a big believer in looking to history, art, science, performance, nature, comics and pretty much everything else as inspirations for both making games, and naming them."
The reason a decent name matters, of course, is that we've got more of the things to choose from than ever. It's another way to make your game visible in the morass.

"Steam is a very densely populated platform these days," Flynn says. "To catch people's interest you only really have the name of your game and the capsule art, and there's only so much they can do. It's really an artform to create both and make them work well together in a way that stands out."

I asked GameDiscoverCo founder Simon Carless about this topic, who offers a slightly different take. "I think it's important that developers pick a name that's not too long and convoluted, and won't be immediately confused with another game. (The Outer Wilds vs. The Outer Worlds being the most famous of those name clashes.)

"Beyond that—I actually think that naming isn't that important, since most people buy a game based on video footage, someone else playing it, or a recommendation. And we've seen in music and elsewhere that weird names are in no way a blocker to becoming successful." Carless cites Steely Dan and Bananarama as examples.
Form vs function
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/LDPJbbveeDgZrz2PNrLB3n-1920-80.jpg

So what defines a good name? "A good name sells the game's vibe," Flynn says. "The feel of how it'll play. There are loads of ways to be successful at this. It could come from a well-known phrase, an idiom, a place name, an artefact, a character's name, or just a concept that reflects the game's theme." Flynn cites a workbook called Don't Call it That , which has helped shape how she thinks about this.

"Finding the right name should feel like a jigsaw piece slotting into place, not that you've completed a 50-step escape room. Big Walk is about having a big walk. If you can, let the game name itself."

This got me thinking about whether the titles of my favourite indie games from the past few years were able to capture their essence. A few certainly did. Ball x Pit? That's a perfect name for that game. Dispatch? The word by itself isn't that evocative, but that does describe the basic act of what you do in the game, and it's simple enough to be memorable. Mouthwashing? That's a cleverly subversive name because it asks the question 'why is it called that?', which the game does pay off.

I think Carless' band analogy is apt—a name can seem clever in retrospect because it has already become iconic. Balatro is a good example of that to me. If LocalThunk's game had 10 reviews on Steam and was completely ignored, I'd probably call that a bad name. Few normal people, after all, would know that Balatro means 'jester' or 'clown' in Latin.

items.title: 《魔兽世界》：Forever 玩家因流媒体未因非法黄金而被禁止而愤怒不已
items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is opening up old wounds when it comes to Blizzard's actions (or in many players' v

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever is opening up old wounds when it comes to Blizzard's actions (or in many players' views, inaction) against bots and real-money gold buying, with a recent incident involving a popular streamer becoming a flashpoint for the MMORPG.

WoW Classic streamer Ziqo was recently seen on stream accepting large sums of gold from strangers in the lead up to a $100,000 WoW: Forever beta dueling tournament on October 17. In a clip in which he was traded 380 gold from a level one character (a huge amount in WoW Classic/Forever, particularly in a beta that's only been out for two weeks), Ziqo can be heard saying there's no way that amount of gold is "natty" but accepts the trade anyways. In another clip , he accepts 175 gold from a different level one character named El Delivery.

The community immediately saw huge cause for concern. Not only did gold buying already appear to be alive and well in the Forever beta after Blizzard previously said it would be more aggressive in taking action against gold buyers, but the streamer looked to be effectively buying his way to victory in the upcoming tournament. With that amount of gold, Ziqo would be able to essentially buy anything he needed in the lead up to the tournament, giving him an advantage. The WoW Classic subreddit became aflame with calls for Blizzard to take action.

Without mentioning Ziqo by name, WoW community manager Kaivax shared Blizzard's stance on real-money transactions (RMT) in WoW: Forever via a forum post on September 28. While Blizzard has always looked to take action and punish gold sellers, Kaivax said, it will increasingly take action against those buying or accepting RMT gold as well.

"It's important to know that while we have always actioned RMT seller's accounts as quickly as possible, we will increasingly take action against buyers' accounts," Kaivax said. "That means that we will remove the illicit gold from the recipient and/or take further actions, which can include closing accounts.

"We're once again asking all players to be very cautious when it comes to accepting gifts from strangers or other one-sided transactions. If it becomes apparent that a recipient knew or should have known that gold wasn't from a legitimate source, they may be subject to account actions as well."
According to Ziqo , Blizzard has since removed the ill-gained gold he received (as well as some additional gold he hardened the old-fashioned-way) but as of writing has not punished him further.

Many on the WoW Classic subreddit are calling for Blizzard to stay true to its words from Kaivax's forum post and take further actions against Ziqo's account, as it's obvious he knew the gold could not have been legitimate.

"We can all agree it's not good for the integrity of the game when streamers get showered with free gold on stream," Reddit user Nino171 writes in a post calling for streamers like Ziqo to be banned just like any regular player would. "Treat everyone equally. Streamers should have to watch what they accept for free, just like any other player."

Even if Ziqo isn't banned from the game, some are calling for him to at the very least be banned from the upcoming tournament by its organizers. Others on the game's forums are calling for Blizzard to ban accounts permanently that are caught engaging in RMT trading, with a call to "make an example of these streamers."

For now, it's unclear if Blizzard will punish Ziqo further with an account ban, but it's definitely caused many in the Forever community to lose faith that Blizzard is willing to put its money where its mouth is in regards to cracking down on those both selling and buying in-game gold.

WoW: Forever's beta , which costs $60 to gain access to, is currently live until October 21. The new version of WoW Classic with over 1,000 new quests , as well as new dungeons, raids, and zones, is proving to be popular , with Blizzard recently stating it had to once again increase the beta's population cap. WoW: Forever will launch in full November 4.

items.summary: 是时候了。
items.titleEn: UK government wants people to be rude to AI: 'You don't need to say thank you'

content.v: 英国政府提醒其员工，当人工智能系统产生输出时，他们不需要感谢人工智能系统，即使输出是正确的。这条有用的说明被纳入了政府关于“道德和可持续地使用人工智能”的指导方针的一部分，并不是因为需要记住这些东西绝对没有感知能力或以任何方式“活着”，而只是因为它们非常昂贵并且对地球有害。
该指南（来自 Tom's Hardware）是一份草案文件，仅作为“支持您的人工智能之旅的起点”。在大多数情况下，这是常识性的东西：仔细检查输出以确保它们准确且无偏见，并且不要提供任何您不希望用于训练目的的输入，因为很可能它会被用于训练目的。
还有一条说明，你拥有这项工作，并对这项工作负责：价值数十亿美元的人工智能公司也许可以将矛头指向“流氓特工”，但职业公务员没有这样的免责条款。
但真正让我印象深刻的是“不要感谢你的人工智能”，这是有效使用人工智能的三个指导方针之一，“以减少对环境的影响：
当银行提款机吐出我的现金时，我有时会感谢它，我会默默地向自己证明这个习惯，认为良好的举止是值得鼓励的。不过，如今，我对整件事的看法更像是罗恩·斯旺森（Ron Swanson）：
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dZjoKBLcTruviAyXLV5LcM-1920-80.gif
坦率地说，我认为“认识到将法学硕士拟人化的心理危险”可能是对机器粗鲁的最好理由。但令我感到高兴的是，它最终被归入“效率”类别。
还记得当“使用人工智能或失去工作”是一件大事时，每个人都在进行代币最大化，但随着成本开始飙升（而收入却没有），公司开始放弃统一的订阅价格，转而采用按代币付费的模式？事实证明，这变得非常昂贵，非常快，突然之间，正如英国政府所说，“考虑是否有更简单的工具可以完成这项工作（例如电子表格或搜索引擎）”变得非常重要。
就实际影响而言，我认为对人工智能无礼就像担心深夜开车去商店会影响我个人的碳足迹一样有用，而我们正在摧毁加沙并在整个非洲大陆修建管道。但作为另一个默认的说法，也许我们对人工智能的依赖并不像人们所吹捧的那样？我全心全意地赞同它。

items.summary: 这款基于照片的冒险游戏超级甜蜜，但有点太容易捕捉解决冒险游戏的欢乐
items.titleEn: Toem 2 review: A sweet sequel that's a tad too easy to be memorable

content.v: 它是什么？：一款探索型冒险游戏，拍照永远是答案。发布日期：2026 年 9 月 29 日 预计售价：17 美元 / 13.59 英镑 开发者：Something We Made 发行商：popagenda 评论平台：Intel Core Ultra 7 265、RTX 5070 Ti、32GB RAM 多人游戏：无 Steam Deck：已验证链接：Steam
冒险游戏中充满了需要解决问题的人，在《Toem 2》中，就像在原版中一样，解决方案通常是用我光滑的老式动态变焦相机拍摄一张新照片。这次，奶奶送我去坐公交车，去看那棵婆娑的白桦树那难以捉摸的花香。我只能通过完成沿途每一站的任务来获得前往下一个城镇的车票。
在这四个城镇中的每一个，我都可以自由地探索，寻找需要我可以用我的多功能多连接相机提供的任何帮助的当地人。为了解决我的麻烦，他们会在我的日记上盖章，当我有足够的邮票去参观公交车线路的下一站时，我的探索就会继续。
Toem 2 的人们需要什么样的基于摄像头的帮助？

https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/XZZtyYTnex8YqVwpCWQ7e8.jpg

一位园丁希望我提供一些创意非盆栽植物的灵感图片。

三只蒲公英想要照片证明它们失踪的兄弟姐妹并未真正失踪。
有些任务是更传统的无相机冒险游戏任务
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/jK2hhPihEi9vcGSdX4j7q6.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/YRLrTKrbprdEZN3iemcvi8.jpg
一只害怕的稻草人猫要我把他带到一个没有讨厌的鸟的新栖息地。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/i8m6XVpy6R7MVDmaxrCUa4.jpg
一位患有严重呕吐的骑士需要一种药水来治疗他们的伤势。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/fTC3R72UsjX844eyJCV2YM.jpg
城市里有一个密室逃脱，谁能破解它，奖品就等着你。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/wJ988WG3qsooKdPaVYmd97.jpg
Toem 2 有很多可收藏的服装。我最喜欢的是我的角色头像的大吉祥物版本。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/SPSV8WyS6oDwoA8YqnPHK7.jpg
和原版一样，我也有一份小动物纲要，如果我想成为一个完美主义者，我可以抓拍它们。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/fAdfyhT4zjnGus5VDCF8K7.jpg
用于高级自拍模式的机载相机三脚架使用起来非常有趣。有时我会站在桌子或障碍物上，将直升机相机展开到空中进行鸟瞰。
这一切有点太自动了
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8DB8rC2duVRMDVqeoJdWk6.jpg
在最初的托姆中，我只需要从一个区域的任何任务中收集足够的邮票，就可以跳上巴士前往下一个目的地。 《Toem 2》每个区域的主线任务都更加清晰。每个地点都有一个特殊的相机附件和一个不幸的当地人的组合，在我继续我的旅程之前，他需要我的帮助来使用它。帮助这些人不是必需的，但绝对是通向充满朋友的结局的预期途径。
每个附件都有一个非相机功能（第一个是一把剪刀），我通过瞄准取景器并按下按钮来使用。
精简的任务结构讲述了一个可爱的故事。
但它失去了一些冒险游戏的魔力。
优秀的冒险游戏（其中包括最初的《Toem》）会产生真正令人兴奋的解谜感觉。你看到一个问题。您想象一些可能的解决方案。你四处走动，最终……“哦哦哦哦，现在我明白了！”
你知道这句话吗？ “对于一个拿着锤子的人来说，一切看起来都像钉子。” Toem 2 给了我一把锤子，但实际上只给了我钉子。我通常不需要创造性地思考来理解问题。我只需要四处走动，直到看到我的相机能力的下一个明显用途。
在我最喜欢的冒险游戏中，任务几乎是谜语般的提示，而不是直接的指示。当我的大脑“咔嗒”一声找到我一直在寻找的答案时，喜悦就来了。在《Toem 2》中，我进行了大量的镜头点击操作，但很少进行大脑点击操作。这是一部快速而甜蜜的续集，但简单的目标让它感觉不如原作那么有创新性。

content.v: Xbox Insiders 的神话成就将于今天开始正式推出，微软已经提供了有关其新里程碑系统如何运作的更多详细信息。旨在庆祝用户在其 PC 和游戏机历史上解锁的最大 Xbox 成就（类似于 PlayStation 白金奖杯）只要获得游戏的所有原始成就，即可获得神话成就。

微软补充说，以后通过 DLC 或更新添加的成就不是必需的，一旦你获得了神话状态，你就可以永远保留它。这将追溯应用，因此，如果您多年来在任何 Xbox 游戏中取得了最大成就，预计会看到一条 15 秒的通知，告诉您做得有多好。一旦完整的神话成就系统向整个 Xbox 社区推出，玩家个人资料将通过新的游戏选项卡进行更新，他们可以在其中查看自己的成就、跟踪下一个 Gamerscore 里程碑徽章并重新访问游戏。
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Mythic-4.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Mythic-2.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Mythic-3.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Mythic-1.jpg?w=636
这将使您更容易跟踪获得神话成就的进度，因为每个游戏成就列表顶部的新进度条将准确显示您距离获得神话状态有多近。还有一个选项可以专注于您仍然需要的原始成就，并且稍后添加的成就将收到“附加”标签，以使追逐更清晰可循。目前尚不清楚神话成就何时会从 Xbox Insiders 计划向其他 Xbox 用户群推出。

Xbox 首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马 (Asha Sharma) 在 8 月份曾调侃称，“神话成就”即将到来，但它们是在微软游戏部门另一轮大规模裁员期间到来的。 Xbox 各个部门又裁员了数百人，动视和 Bethesda 旗下的开发人员也被整合，Xbox 游戏工作室的投资组合也随着多个团队的退出而萎缩。 Ninja Theory 的未来看起来充满不确定性，而 Undead Labs 已开始缩小规模，作为其转向新所有者（未公开）的一部分。

items.title: 为什么控制共振显影剂补救措施避免使用黄色油漆来引导玩家
items.summary: Control Resonant 的总监解释了团队如何选择以一种不让人感觉的方式来处理探索
items.titleEn: Why Control Resonant Developer Remedy Avoided Using Yellow Paint to Guide Players

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/18/controlresonant-review-blogroll-1789695360175.jpg
Control Resonant 的总监解释了团队如何选择以一种不会让人感觉用黄色油漆之类的东西握住玩家的手的方式来处理探索。
多年来，一些游戏玩家开始觉得游戏为玩家提供了不必要的指导。其中一个例子是黄色油漆，它基本上突出显示了玩家在探索过程中需要去的地方。批评者说，当这种导航设备过于严厉时，它可能会分散注意力并消除代理感。例如，漫威的《金刚狼》因其“屁气”而受到严厉批评，“屁气”是金刚狼可以嗅出的蓝色雾气来找到他的目标。发布后不久，开发商 Insomniac 添加了关闭它的功能。

Control Resonant 的开发商 Remedy 并没有打败玩家。这是一款开放世界游戏，玩家可以自由探索不同的区域，尽管有时并不总是清楚该去哪里。 Control Resonant 总监 Mikael Kasurinen 在 Dropping Frames 播客（来自 Kotaku）中解释说，让玩家感觉自己正在弄清楚这个复杂的世界，而不是跟随闪烁的箭头，这一点很重要。他指出，为了让玩家充分利用这个世界，他们必须成为积极的参与者。
卡苏里宁说：“让玩家感觉自己是解决问题的人，这一点非常重要。” “作为创作者，我们的工作就是……我的意思是，归根结底，这是一种精心设计的体验，对吧？你必须在‘这就是世界’和‘这是你必须注意的不同主题和元素’之间找到适当的平衡。但你必须感觉自己决定如何处理你在世界上看到的这些元素。如果感觉像是‘去这里’，那就不再是玩家的决定了。已经有人帮你决定了。”
导演接着指出，Remedy 认识到它可能会疏远那些寻求更具引导性和简单体验的玩家，但对于那些真正参与其中的人来说，这将是更有价值和更有趣的。
“人们会回到这个游戏，探索，试图找出一些东西等等，”他补充道。 “这不是你经历过的事情，你按照别人告诉你的去做，然后你就完成了。感觉就像，不，我在这个游戏中做了一些选择，然后你有一个小问题：我做出了正确的选择吗？我想要这个该死的问题。我希望人们这样思考。我希望他们有点，你知道，怀疑，回去，再次检查，看看他们可以做些什么不同的事情，因为这就是生活。这就是它的粘性和有趣的原因。“
另一个与 Remedy 理念相似的开发商是 Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons 工作室 Invoke。 Invoke Studios 总经理 Dominic Guay 在 gamescom 2026 上告诉 IGN，开发人员避免在游戏中添加路径点，因为他们希望玩家能够真正探索。
这款开放世界的单人动作冒险游戏放弃了引导玩家直接从一个故事部分进入下一个故事部分的传统任务标记，从而简化了手持操作。虽然屏幕顶部确实有一个指南针（您可以将其关闭），但玩家只能通过探索、与 NPC 交谈并思考下一步该做什么来确定该去哪里。
盖伊说：“我们希望他们与世界接触，弄清楚事情，并感觉到当他们发现事情时，这是基于他们的行动，而不仅仅是盲目地相信一个路径点。”
IGN 的 Control Resonant 评价为 8/10。我们说：“即使战斗的锋利最终会变得迟钝，控制共振也是补救宇宙的一个伟大补充，”评论摘录中写道。 “虽然它的故事遵循更标准的框架，但它的吸引力在于围绕它构建的创造性世界以及为超自然阴谋奠定基础的人性化。”

items.title: 分析师表示，Xbox 上《战争机器：E-Day》的大部分收入将被游戏通行证蚕食
items.summary: 《战争机器：E-Day》将在 Xbox Game Pass 上推出，正因为如此，该游戏的大部分收入都来自于
items.titleEn: Majority Of Gears Of War: E-Day Revenue On Xbox Will Be Cannibalized By Game Pass, Analyst Says

content.v: 《战争机器：E-Day》将在 Xbox Game Pass 上推出，因此，该游戏的大部分盈利潜力将因包含在该服务中而被蚕食。这是 Alinea Analytics 的 Rhys Elliott 的说法，他今天发布了一份报告，其中涵盖了该游戏在 Steam 上的首次销售，以及将来移植到 PlayStation 5 的可能性。
据 Elliott 称，E-Day 目前在 Steam 上的销量已超过 120,000 份，创造了超过 700 万美元的收入。该游戏将于 10 月 6 日上市，但支付更多费用的玩家可以从 10 月 1 日开始抢先体验。欲了解更多信息，请查看 E-Day 的官方全球发布时间。
Elliott 的数据显示，《E-Day》的销量已经是《光环：战役进化》同期销量的 2 倍多。埃利奥特表示，E-Day 在 Steam 上的销量已经达到 12 万份，但不太可能在该平台上突破 100 万份。
此外，他表示 Xbox 版本的“大部分”收入将“被 Game Pass 吞噬”。该游戏包含在 Game Pass 中也可能会鼓励一些人注册，因此仅凭销量并不能说明全部情况。

无论如何，微软已经决定将一些关键游戏从 Game Pass 中撤出，大概是因为收入损失。例如，微软动视部门不再将新的《使命召唤》游戏放入 Game Pass 中，今年 10 月的《现代战争 4》要到 2027 年秋季才会加入 Game Pass。展望未来，Xbox 首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马 (Asha Sharma) 表示，该公司可能会选择“窗口化”其他游戏，大概是为了帮助微软从直接游戏销售中赚更多钱。
2023年，微软承认将游戏放入Game Pass会蚕食整个游戏的销量。同时，进入 Game Pass 的游戏在某些场景下实际上可以帮助提高销量。
微软在 Xbox Game Pass 上下了大赌注，斥资数十亿美元收购了工作室，目的是将内容输送到该服务中以鼓励人们注册。 Xbox 新任首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马 (Asha Sharma) 表示，微软对 Game Pass 的押注没有成功。 “我们的核心业务减弱了，我们增加了更多的团队、更多的投入、更多的时间，希望能有更好的结果，”她说。
埃利奥特此前曾表示，《战争机器：E-Day》（以及《发条革命》）由于其在 Xbox 上的独占性而将被送去死亡。它们也将登陆 PC，但不会登陆 PS5。
埃利奥特告诉 GameSpot，微软永远不会在游戏机领域取得成功，并且承诺为粉丝提供独家游戏来帮助推动游戏机销售也不会产生任何影响。
“据我们所知，Xbox 的主机时代已经结束了，而且已经有一段时间了。这艘船无法转动。但他们仍然需要假装关心，直到他们过渡到可以恢复增长的牧场（如果他们成功的话），”他说。
“Gears 游戏机的独占性不会改变 X 系列设备的有意义数量。作为硬件驱动程序的独占性对他们来说已经结束，因为它所驱动的安装基础根本没有足够的响应能力来证明以 5 倍组件溢价构建硬件的成本是合理的。无论如何，这些游戏都在 Steam 上，”他补充道。
埃利奥特接着说，《战争机器：E-Day》和《发条革命》是“为了心灵而不是为了经济而牺牲的羔羊”。
埃利奥特也在报告中回应了微软取消《E-Day》PS5 移植版的传闻。他表示微软不应该这样做，因为将游戏引入 PS5 将会“增加一些急需的额外收入”。
虽然《E-Day》可能不会在 PS5 发布时登陆，但 Elliott 表示，他预计“在某个时候”会有一个移植版本进入市场。
有明显证据表明《E-Day》是 PS5 版。不过，微软否认在最后一刻取消了PS5版本，但并没有否认它的存在。
这个故事的另一个奇怪的问题是，微软的 Aaron Greenberg 表示 E-Day 并不是 Xbox 的限时独占活动。不过，格林伯格在 2021 年表示《Starfield》并不是 Xbox 上的限时独占游戏，但后来它确实来到了 PS5，因此很难相信微软关于其发布计划的一些说法。

items.title: 我的 GTA 5 安装有一种死亡的愿望，但我用牙线缓解了它
items.summary: 这对我有用。
items.titleEn: My GTA 5 install has a death wish but I have soothed it with flossing

content.v: 我每天都在修改《GTA 5》，要么将其转变为 PC 版的《GTA 6》，要么彻底破坏它。明天回来看看我对 Rockstar 的宝宝做了什么新的可怕的事情，或者看看我之前做了什么。
现在我的动作有些焦虑。死亡的恶臭在《侠盗猎车手 5》中挥之不去，就像热雨过后的臭气一样，我担心任何添加内容最终都会将其推向边缘。
正如我们之前所确定的，游戏现在只能在窗口模式下正常启动，一旦它完成了我给它带来的所有修改，它就会把我放在富兰克林·克林顿的房子曾经所在的空旷空间中，让他跌入深渊。每次我加载 GTA 5 时，富兰克林都会尖叫。
不管怎样，我添加了一个新的模组。它被称为《堡垒之夜》牙线舞蹈 [OIV]，并添加了“平滑循环的牙线舞蹈，与《堡垒之夜》相同的速度”。方便是它的理念：每当您开始使用牙线时，音乐就会自动播放，这样您就不会看起来很奇怪。不喜欢音乐？它的音量由滑块控制。另外，整个用户界面都是阿拉伯语的，这是我下载时没想到的，但它增加了一些我非常喜欢的难以定义的东西。
说什么？富兰克林现在使用牙线。他不分青红皂白、不知疲倦地使用牙线。没有什么可以阻止他。半删除的洛桑托斯持续的混乱并没有让他感到困扰。他的保镖不断地消亡和补充，他并不关心。用车撞他，他只会自己恢复过来并继续前进。只有他、音乐和用一种我不会说的语言发出的命令，但我必须假设它是“开始用牙线清洁”。

items.title: 克雷格的《生化危机》电影在不到两周的时间内就在国内票房超过 1 亿美元，成为票房第三高的 RE 电影
items.summary: 还有一些地方需要弥补。
items.titleEn: Cregger's Resident Evil film is already the 3rd highest grossing RE film with over $100 million at the domestic box office in under 2 weeks

content.v: 扎克·克雷格 (Zach Cregger) 在他最近的《生化危机》电影中对生存恐怖的诠释非常受欢迎——只要询问 PC Gamer 的任何人，他们都会告诉你他们有多么喜欢这种诠释。但《生化危机》不仅获得了好评，而且还赚得盆满钵满。
克雷格的《生化危机》第二周在美国和加拿大票房收入达 2,300 万美元（通过 Fangoria），仅次于重新上映的《复仇者联盟：终局之战》，后者在《复仇者联盟：世界末日》之前重返影院。但《生化危机》确实击败了布拉德·皮特的《野兽之心》和克里斯·汉森的传记片黄金时段，这是一个相当令人印象深刻的成就。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZHPzXKPtm25AvzEyWKY8Lg-1920-80.png
2300 万美元听起来可能不是很多，尤其是当你把它与索尼影业制作这部电影的高达 7500 万美元相比时，所以《生化危机》总体上赚了更多钱是一件好事。从数据来看，克雷格的《生化危机》已经是《生化危机》系列电影中第三大最赚钱的电影，首周末票房收入为 6000 万美元，国内总票房为 1.03 亿美元，全球票房高达 1.97 亿美元。
有趣的是，克雷格的《生化危机》轻松成为有史以来国内票房最高的《生化危机》电影，保罗·W·S·安德森的《生化危机：来世》排名第二，《生化危机：堕落与灭绝》争夺第三位。
但全球票房却讲述了一个不同的故事。在这里，克雷格的《生化危机》仍然位居第四，落后于《生化危机：最终章》的 3.14 亿美元票房，以及《生化危机：来世》和《生化危机：报应》。
到目前为止，《生化危机》票房前五名的总排名如下：
克雷格的《生化危机》仍然有一些不足需要弥补，但由于它只发布了几周，所以我对它超越其他游戏的能力非常有信心。

items.title: 如果陀思妥耶夫斯基《罪与罚》中的每个主要角色都必须在光环 1 的情节中生存下来，他们会如何应对
items.summary: 这是正确的。我终于做到了。
items.titleEn: How every major character in Dostoevsky's Crime and Punishment would fare if they had to survive the plot of Halo 1

content.v: 所有其他游戏作者都是胆小鬼。财富和权力合谋迫使他们保持沉默，只关心琐事而不是真正重要的事情。但不是我。我很勇敢，也很坚强，我的声音不会被压制。我不在乎说出真相所带来的后果。这是其他媒体不敢写的文章。
如果《罪与罚》的主要角色必须在《光环 1》的剧情中幸存下来，他们的处境如下。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8uQ33MhCWuhcBc5Vsm5vxd.jpg
罗迪昂·罗曼诺维奇·拉斯科尔尼科夫
罗迪亚的近战专长将引导他顺利通过秋之柱，近距离让他能够与步兵和精英近距离接触，但我对他在更广泛、范围更广的真理与和解剧场中自主运作的能力持怀疑态度。为了便于论证，假设他能够熟悉聚焦等离子火力的节奏来摧毁敌人的护盾，然后迅速切换到 M6 手枪来消灭他们，我认为他会在 343 Guilty Spark 中崩溃，其中洪水第一次出现的恐怖和人类悲剧将使他受到创伤直至瘫痪。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QB2PshnY4TRWofqJUhCA6X.jpg
德米特里·普罗科菲伊奇·拉祖米欣
拉祖米欣（Razumikhin）的名字或多或少可以翻译为“大脑家伙”，他无疑会证明自己是一位精明的战略家，但当他在《突击控制室》中屠杀一间充满熟睡咕噜声的房间时，他富有同理心的人性的核心就会从资产变成障碍。最终，拉祖米欣的生存几率将取决于他是单人模式还是合作模式，因为在后一种情况下，他将成为一名更无情的战士的熟练支持者，而后者可以弥补德米特里温和的学术倾向。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/NkNNApzZc3t8pj8eKcb3qW.jpg
谢苗·扎哈罗维奇·马尔梅拉多夫
被疣猪碾碎了。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/uBdXexdmttBgNk9XG3vg4X.jpg
索菲亚·谢苗诺夫娜·马尔梅拉多娃

作为陀思妥耶夫斯基小说中的道德核心，索菲亚似乎不适合 Bungie 2001 年开创性的第一人称射击游戏对她提出的要求。但不要把她排除在外。她也许是书中最不知疲倦的角色，拒绝抛弃拉斯科尔尼科夫，让他因不可饶恕的罪行而感到羞耻和内疚，就像她可能拒绝在没有天蝎坦克支援的情况下离开一个排的海军陆战队员一样。她的弱点不在于她的战斗力，而在于她强烈的宗教信仰，这可能会导致她加入星盟，成为光环 1 中与俄罗斯东正教最相似的教会。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/sGdbc9jqZN8tiAmxpTPZoW.jpg
阿夫多佳·罗曼诺芙娜·拉斯科尔尼科娃
拉斯柯尔尼科夫的妹妹杜尼娅绝对会独自解决这一切。传奇难度，全骷髅。当她快速穿越《沉默的制图师》等经典关卡时，她使用背包重装和动画取消来将不间断的火力降低到射程范围内。她知道所有的关卡但不会使用它们。 <3小时完成时间。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/M4hGDw3QsoBTfTFV7yPqKX.jpg
阿尔卡季·伊万诺维奇·斯维德里盖洛夫
因语音聊天评论而被禁止。上次上线是在一年前。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qmMdazEVaHvKSVZh6fxQ4X.jpg
彼得·彼得罗维奇·卢仁
杜尼娅这位身体强健的未婚夫实际上从一开始就过得很糟糕。在合作中，他会要求驾驶所有车辆，但并不熟练，而他坚持囤积M41 SPNKr火箭发射器等稀有而强大的武器会大大降低他的部队的战斗力。单打独斗时，这些问题仍然存在，还有一个缺点是他没有球队来弥补他的缺陷。人们也不能忽视这样一种可能性：他只是对科塔娜感到如此奇怪，以至于他会被凯斯船长立即处决。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/A2A3Zs93X7RMs8S8xwif5X.jpg
波尔菲里·彼得罗维奇
几年前在阿尔法光环事件中安静地幸存下来。如果你搜索，你会在《光环：无限》中找到他，但他并不喜欢这个游戏。

items.title: GTA 6 透露 Game Informer 应用因免费覆盖而崩溃
items.summary: 今天，Game Informer 的网站和应用程序在其独家 GTA 6 预览版首次亮相时崩溃，造成混乱
items.titleEn: GTA 6 Reveal Crashes Game Informer App Amid Confusion Over Free Coverage

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/17/gta-6-soundtrack-1789662158949.jpg
今天，Game Informer 的网站和应用程序在其独家《GTA 6》预览版首次亮相时崩溃，在粉丝中造成混乱。
Game Informer 今天发布了长达 14 页的封面故事，其中包含有关 GTA 6 的各种新信息，但不幸的是粉丝们很难访问它。故事一发布，Game Informer 的网站就崩溃了。就在报道发布之前，已确认该故事将通过 Game Informer 的应用程序免费向所有用户开放。正如您可能想象的那样，这导致该网站被流量淹没。
用户花了大约一个小时才开始进入 Game Informer 的网站，以便阅读这个故事。其中充满了独家细节，我们在这里进行了详细介绍。其中一些细节包括确认 GTA 6 将以飓风等热带风暴为特色，这是粉丝们长期以来一直猜测的事情。
尽管今年夏天早些时候已经有各种《GTA 6》预览，其中包括来自 IGN 本身的预览，但仍有更多喘息的空间。预告片在 Rockstar 在 Netflix 上发布 27 分钟的游戏玩法期间发布，并且有多家媒体和创作者进行了独家报道。它让每个人都有一些空间，而这只是吸引GTA 6粉丝所有注意力的一个出口。

As of right now, we're not sure when the next GTA 6 news beat will be. Rockstar has already teased that it will share more about the game's radio stations and music in the coming weeks, and there's hope from fans that we will get one last trailer before launch. Either way, GTA 6 is finally just a little over one month away from launch.

items.title: 向可爱、可怕、精彩的《反恐精英》社区和我的第一次锦标赛经历致敬
items.summary: 我第一次亲自观看 CS2 锦标赛真是太棒了。
items.titleEn: An ode to the loveable, horrible, wonderful Counter-Strike community and my first tournament experience

content.v: “听起来你需要找到一些归属感，一个你可以称之为自己的、有宾至如归的感觉的团体。”
这些话，或类似的话，是我的治疗师最近对我说的。我想她可能想到了一些更传统的东西——教堂，或者那些有男子气概的男性团体，类似的东西——但上周我在波兰华沙的一个工业区中发现了一个解决方案。
那里正在举办 Logitech G Play 2026，其中包括奖金池为 100,000 美元的《反恐精英 2》锦标赛。当我坐在看台座位上，周围都是波兰人时，尽管我听不懂周围的人或波兰评论员通过扬声器所说的话，但我还是有宾至如归的感觉。
舞台上两支队伍——加拿大队Luminosity Gaming和法国队3DMax——面对面，观众排列在四边，舞台上方四边都有大屏幕。
我可以选择坐在指定给贵宾和媒体的区域，那里被封锁，而且明显缺乏露天看台，而是将椅子牢固地固定在地板高度上。不过，我选择坐在看台上，周围有数百名前来观看演出的《CS2》老粉丝。毫无疑问，我以前在自己的比赛中也曾听到过其中一两个人用外语对我大喊大叫。正是我喜欢的样子。这些是我的人。
我玩《反恐精英》已经有十多年了，尽管在那段时间里我曾中断过一些游戏。但除了《CS:GO》首次推出以来，我从未真正进入职业圈——我更喜欢只是玩游戏并提高自己，而不是过多地参与团队和锦标赛。
有时，当我的队友提到我不太熟悉的游戏和职业选手时，这会让我感觉与社区有点脱节。我很高兴，但上周参加比赛让我意识到我错过了什么。
我想我所经历的感觉与体育迷的感受是一样的——至少是那些真正去观看比赛的人。我只喜欢美式足球，这使得作为英国人亲自观看比赛变得很困难，除了偶尔在温布利球场观看比赛之外。
我没有立即投入其中。当我坐下来观看时，我花了一段时间来适应并投入。前一天我与 Luminosity 的几位职业选手进行了交谈，这对我很有帮助，因为我发现与我交谈的两个人——Azuwu 和 yxngstxr——是非常真诚和友好的人，所以我对他们的胜利感到投入（唉，他们没有）。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/JVjrfUqw9onLSJtLtvB5qJ-1920-80.jpg
我很庆幸自己能够熟悉游戏和地图，因为尽管看不懂解说，但我也能理解正在发生的事情。但第一场比赛的大部分时间我都在适应观众模式的节奏和节奏，因为我已经很长一段时间没有观看观众CS2比赛了。
在第一场和第二场比赛之间，很多人冲出看台，出去喝一杯或抽烟，包括我自己。我没有和任何人说话；我不需要。我在昏暗的光线下在外面站了几分钟，期待着回到座位上观看下一场比赛。
在那场比赛中有些时刻让人感到真正的精神
第二场比赛是我全力投入的时候。这也好，因为那场比赛进入了两个加时赛，这至少在我的非职业经验中是非常罕见的。这是一场漫长而势均力敌的比赛，这让一切变得更好。
在那场比赛中，有一些时刻让人感到真正的精神，这说起来是一件疯狂的事情，你不会再听到我重述，以免我的同事永远不会让我失望。当解说员提高解说的张力时，看到 AWP-er 非洲式离合器，然后当他击出一个可笑的投篮时，听到我周围的吼叫声，现在已经深深地烙印在我的脑海里。
愚蠢的事情也是如此，比如观众（包括我自己）将我们的建筑咆哮声推向高潮，因为两名对方球员在不知不觉中相互接近。或者，回合间的镜头切换到坐在我旁边一排的一位观众，他拿出笔记本电脑，打开战利品箱，当他交叉手指以获得稀有皮肤而不是浪费金钱时，再次发出一声建筑怒吼。
在他们公司的几个小时让我非常感激社区和多年来我花了很多时间在头脑中射击的玩家。
灯光，轰鸣而低音的音频，整个体验让我觉得自己是个傻瓜，错过了这么久。但更重要的是，我觉得我最怀念的是共同的体验，即通过对游戏的热爱与他人建立联系的感觉。
这感觉很愚蠢，对于一款我花了这么多时间投入这么多年的游戏，直到现在我还没有尝试过亲自与它可爱的、有毒的、满嘴脏话的社区建立联系，分享锦标赛的经验。
我希望能与这些人进行更多 FaceIt 匹配，无论他们用多少种语言侮辱我的母亲。在内心深处，我们知道我们彼此相爱，也爱着这款令人难以置信的游戏。有时只需要一点面对面的、无语言障碍的联系就能实现这一点。归属感如何？

content.v: 瑞士开发商 Urban Games（《火车狂热》《狂热运输2》）与发行商 Paradox Interactive（《城市：天际线》系列）今日正式推出《狂热运输3》。作为这一广受好评的运输模拟系列的最新作，本作现已通过 Steam、Epic Games Store 与 GOG 登陆 PC、Mac 与 Linux 平台，同时登陆 PlayStation 5 与 Xbox Series X|S。
https://image.gcores.com/cd4bb84a9e09aaddf701f5bb19f71034-1920-1080.jpg
在发售前收获热烈反响与玩家高度期待之后，《狂热运输3》于今日推出标准版、豪华版与典藏版。
发售之前，《狂热运输3》便已在全球玩家中赢得瞩目，一举登上 Steam 全球热销榜第5位，并在德国区位列第1。
系列迄今最大的技术与模拟飞跃
《狂热运输3》在系列标志性的运输经营玩法之上，实现了迄今最大的技术与模拟飞跃，让玩家在构建交通网络时拥有更高的自由度，也让运营所处的世界更加鲜活多变。
https://image.gcores.com/1951f900e1754979bafd745aa5e91636-1920-1080.jpg
本作邀请玩家在四种截然不同的环境中设计、建造并经营横跨铁路、公路、航运与航线的运输帝国——温带、沙漠、热带，以及全新加入的亚寒带。每一种环境都带来独特的挑战与玩法可能，背后则是大幅升级的地形生成技术，以及一个动态的全模拟世界：城镇与产业会随玩家的每一步决策而演变。
玩家可以在跨越百年的技术革新中打造自己的运输帝国，可用载具超过 300 种，涵盖列车、巴士、有轨电车、卡车、船舶、飞机，以及系列首次登场的直升机。
开发者寄语
"从创业之初起，我们就把全部的工作时间、乃至许多个夜晚，投入到一份深深打动我们的热情之中：模拟游戏。从我们的第一部成功之作《火车狂热》，到《狂热运输》《狂热运输2》，再到今天的《狂热运输3》，我们始终怀抱同一个理想——做出我们自己也梦想去玩的游戏。" Urban Games 创始人兼首席执行官 Basil Weber 在谈及工作室的理念时表示。
https://image.gcores.com/4ed763c4ca390718ba9ab0ae1ffb2eaf-1920-1080.jpg
"在《狂热运输》上，我们对每一处细节都格外用心。这是一个精雕细琢、近乎手工打造的过程，就像瑞士制表一样。我们倾注了全部的心血。"
《狂热运输3》各版本定价

豪华版： Steam 258 元人民币；主机版 HK$568.00
